lines.text: The Four Phases

lines.text: Initiation: the authenticator sends EAP-Request-Identity, or the supplicant sends EAPoL-Start. Only EAPoL, CDP, and STP pass before authorization.
lines.spoken: Initiation: the authenticator sends eep-Request-Identity, or the supplicant sends E-pole-Start. Only E-pole, CDP, and STP pass before authorization.

lines.text: Authentication: the authenticator puts the EAP message in a RADIUS Access-Request AV pair. The EAP method, such as EAP-TLS, is negotiated.
lines.spoken: Authentication: the authenticator puts the eep message in a radius Access-Request AV pair. The eep method, such as eep T.L.S., is negotiated.

lines.text: Authorization: the server sends Access-Accept with a VLAN and a dACL (VLAN 88 in the example). The authenticator sends EAP-Success to the supplicant.
lines.spoken: Authorization: the server sends Access-Accept with a V-lan and a D-A.C.L. (V-lan 88 in the example). The authenticator sends eep-Success to the supplicant.

lines.text: Accounting: the session is recorded.

lines.text: The supplicant ends the session with EAPoL-Logoff.
lines.spoken: The supplicant ends the session with E-pole-Logoff.

lines.text: Changes the authorization of an active session without the user reconnecting.
lines.spoken: Changes the authorization of an active session without the user reconnecting.

lines.text: The DAC can be co-resident with the RADIUS server.
lines.spoken: The DAC can be co-resident with the radius server.

lines.text: Uses Filter-ID or NAS-Filter-Rule to change the session's filtering.
lines.spoken: Uses Filter-ID or NAS-Filter-Rule to change the session's filtering.

lines.text: CoA after a VPN posture check removes the need for an Inline Posture Node.
lines.spoken: CoA after a VPN posture check removes the need for an Inline Posture Node.

lines.text: VPN posture flow:
lines.spoken: VPN posture flow:

lines.text: 1. The VPN client connects to the firewall and logs in.
lines.spoken: 1. The VPN client connects to the firewall and logs in.

lines.text: 2. The firewall redirects web traffic to ISE.
lines.spoken: 2. The firewall redirects web traffic to ice.

lines.text: 3. The user is provisioned with AnyConnect and its Compliance Module.
lines.spoken: 3. The user is provisioned with AnyConnect and its Compliance Module.

lines.text: 4. AnyConnect checks the client against the posture rules (patches, antivirus, services, applications, registry entries).
lines.spoken: 4. AnyConnect checks the client against the posture rules (patches, antivirus, services, applications, registry entries).

lines.text: 5. The results go to ISE.
lines.spoken: 5. The results go to ice.

lines.text: 6. If compliant, ISE sends a RADIUS CoA to the ASA with the new authorization policies.
lines.spoken: 6. If compliant, ice sends a radius CoA to the ASA with the new authorization policies.

lines.text: 7. The user gets access to internal resources.
lines.spoken: 7. The user gets access to internal resources.

lines.text: C3PL
lines.spoken: C 3 P L.

lines.text: Available on IOS 15.2.x and IOS-XE 3.6.x.
lines.spoken: Available on I.O.S. 15.2.x and I.O.S. X.E. 3.6.x.

lines.text: Built on events, conditions (class maps), and actions.
lines.spoken: Built on events, conditions (class maps), and actions.

lines.text: Once C3PL is configured, you can't go back to the legacy display.
lines.spoken: Once C 3 P L is configured, you can't go back to the legacy display.

lines.text: Benefits:
lines.spoken: Benefits:

lines.text: The configuration exists in memory only once.
lines.spoken: The configuration exists in memory only once.

lines.text: 802.1X and MAB can run at the same time, so DHCP isn't delayed.
lines.spoken: 802 dot 1 X and mab can run at the same time, so DHCP isn't delayed.

lines.text: Service templates provide a Critical ACL when RADIUS is down.
lines.spoken: Service templates provide a Critical ACL when radius is down.

lines.text: Differentiated authentication can use different servers per method.
lines.spoken: Differentiated authentication can use different servers per method.

lines.text: Critical MAB uses a local MAC list when RADIUS is down.
lines.spoken: Critical mab uses a local mac list when radius is down.

lines.text: Legacy devices use a static ACL that denies access (a DoS) while RADIUS is down.
lines.spoken: Legacy devices use a static ACL that denies access (a D.O.S.) while radius is down.

lines.text: Port Authentication Behavior
lines.spoken: Port Authentication Behavior.

lines.text: Default 802.1X behavior: deny the port when authentication fails.
lines.spoken: Default 802 dot 1 X behavior: deny the port when authentication fails.

lines.text: Next came the Auth-Fail VLAN, then Flex-Auth.
lines.spoken: Next came the Auth-Fail V-lan, then Flex-Auth.

lines.text: The switch sends EAP-Identity-Requests periodically, and a supplicant can send EAPoL-Start.
lines.spoken: The switch sends eep-Identity-Requests periodically, and a supplicant can send E-pole-Start.

lines.text: MAB runs after the 802.1X timeout.
lines.spoken: mab runs after the 802 dot 1 X timeout.

lines.text: Running 802.1X and MAB at the same time with 802.1X priority is not recommended for production.
lines.spoken: Running 802 dot 1 X and mab at the same time with 802 dot 1 X priority is not recommended for production.

lines.text: Host Modes
lines.spoken: Host Modes.

lines.text: Single host (default): one MAC per port.
lines.spoken: Single host (default): one mac per port.

lines.text: Multi-Auth: unlimited MACs, each authenticated separately. Best practice in the early TrustSec phases.
lines.spoken: Multi-Auth: unlimited macs, each authenticated separately. Best practice in the early TrustSec phases.

lines.text: MDA (Multi-Domain Authentication): one MAC in the data domain and one in the voice domain. Used in the enforcement phase.
lines.spoken: MDA (Multi-Domain Authentication): one mac in the data domain and one in the voice domain. Used in the enforcement phase.

lines.text: Port Security is not compatible with 802.1X.
lines.spoken: Port Security is not compatible with 802 dot 1 X.

lines.text: Open Authentication: all traffic flows before authentication. Useful for PXE boot and thin clients.
lines.spoken: Open Authentication: all traffic flows before authentication. Useful for PXE boot and thin clients.

lines.spoken: Replication.
